name: desktop-art-direction-fit
goal: Keep the default art direction fully visible in expanded game-view settings at every viewport

evidence: Visual review 2 rejects mobile multiple, readonly and settings-open captures: the default art-direction final line is cut by a two-row textarea.

The existing GameViewFields cases checked presence and enabled/read-only controls, while review wrongly accepted clipping as scrolling. Add a post-capture scrollHeight/clientHeight guard to the same nine viewport cases.
